Sidney Starr Arrested On Child Sex Crime Charges In Georgia

By
Xaviera Bryant
-
August 3, 2026
Share

    Sponsored by

    Instaread

    Reality TV personality Sidney Starr has been arrested in Georgia and is facing multiple felony charges stemming from an alleged incident involving a juvenile.

    LawEnforcement

    According to the Hapeville Police Department, officers responded to the Embassy Suites hotel on International Boulevard on Sunday, August 2, where an investigation led to the arrest of Sidney Favors, who is professionally known as Sidney Starr.

    Authorities say Sidney was taken into custody at the scene before being booked into the Fulton County Jail.

     Court records show Sidney has been charged with aggravated  child molestation, sodomy, and sexual battery against a child under the age of 16.

    Because the case involves a juvenile, Hapeville police said they will not release any additional information.

    The investigation has now been turned over to the Fulton County District Attorney’s Office for prosecution.

    At this time, no trial date has been announced, and the allegations have not been tested in  court.

    What Investigators Allege

    According to booking records cited by multiple outlets, investigators allege the incident occurred at the Embassy Suites hotel in Hapeville.

    Reports also claim Sidney admitted to performing oral sex on the minor during the investigation.

    People& Society

    Those allegations remain unproven, and Sidney has not publicly responded to the charges.

    Sidney Starr’s Mother Speaks Out

    Sidney’s mother, Stephanie Favors, says she was completely blindsided by the allegations and does not believe her daughter committed the crimes she’s accused of.

    She told TMZ the accusations are “completely out of character” and said Sidney was in Georgia for a booked appearance at the time of the alleged incident.

    Stephanie also said she has not been able to speak with Sidney since the arrest because she remains in custody.

    Who Is Sidney Starr?

    Sidney Starr rose to prominence through social media before appearing on reality television shows including “Love & Hip Hop: New York,” “Baddies ATL,” and “Wild ‘N Out.”

    She also made headlines years ago after admitting she fabricated claims that she had a sexual relationship with rapper Chingy, a controversy he has long said negatively impacted his career.

    Related: Chingy Recalls How Sidney Starr’s Lie Derailed His Career 

    What Happens Next?

    For now, Sidney Starr remains in the Fulton County Jail while the Fulton County District Attorney’s Office reviews the case.

    Demographics

    As with any criminal case, the charges are allegations, and Sidney Starr is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in court.
